assignment.title: Quadratic coarea bound
assignment.task: Attack sup_y integral_{Q=y} prod f_i/|grad Q| by coarea or an equivalent interval bound, preserving arbitrary product densities. Prove a uniform geometric inequality or identify a precise missing factor.

partner_status: No completed account03/B05 qform handoff found at fresh read; did not wait.

peer_results_applied.result: Definite original-coordinate 2x2 principal block B gives ||p_Q||_inf <= pi/sqrt(|det B|); rank-three Walsh projection shows every such pair may have determinant O(n^-2).
Diagonal target has density bound pi; law-uniform pointwise one-variable Fresnel decay is false.
Sharp one-square L^{3/2} estimate and unnormalized pair-kernel symmetrization route.

proved_or_verified.statement: For cube product density and an explicit delocalized orthonormal two-plane E, integral_{E^perp} sup_{z in E} F(w+z) dw = n/2 for every even n.
proved_or_verified.scope: Mechanism counterexample to fiber-sup coarea completion; not a counterexample to the target.

proved_or_verified.statement: Exact identity |phi_A(t)|^2=int prod_i K_i(u_i,t(Au)_i)du with |K_i|<=h_i, int h_i=1, h_i<=1 and int int |K_i|^2=pi(int f_i^2)^2<=pi.
proved_or_verified.scope: Product-preserving symmetrized representation; bare L2 closure remains insufficient.

proved_or_verified.statement: For 1<p<2 and Z=lambda X^2+bX+c with density(X)<=K, ||p_Z||_p <= [2^{p-1}/(2-p)]^{1/p} K^{2-2/p}|lambda|^{1/p-1}.

mechanism_refuted: Two-dimensional same-sign spectral coarea followed by fiberwise amplitude supremum: explicit cube projection cost n/2.
One symmetrization followed by absolute values and only generic L2 pair-kernel Brascamp-Lieb: ideal rank-three scaling gives only |phi|=O(|t|^-3/4), not an L1 envelope.
first_unresolved_implication: Prove a dimension-free nonlinear/multilinear coarea or small-ball inequality that retains coordinate product averaging and spends the third large spectral direction to pay the Theta(n) projection-volume loss; equivalently couple pair-kernel u-marginal masses with the Moyal budgets strongly enough to avoid square-root loss.
